description: Figure: PstS hydropathy with no transmembrane segment, and N-terminal contrast against the lipid-anchored M. tuberculosis PstS1 ortholog
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, requests, json

ec = ("MKVMRTTVATVVAATLSMSAFSVFAEASLTGAGATFPAPVYAKWADTYQKETGNKVNYQGIGSSGGVKQIIANTVDFGASDAPLSDEKLAQEGLFQFPTVIGG"
      "VVLAVNIPGLKSGELVLDGKTLGDIYLGKIKKWDDEAIAKLNPGLKLPSQNIAVVRRADGSGTSFVFTSYLAKVNEEWKNNVGTGSTVKWPIGLGGKGNDGIAA"
      "FVQRLPGAIGYVEYAYAKQNNLAYTKLISADGKPVSPTEENFANAAKGADWSKTFAQDLTNQKGEDAWPITSTTFILIHKDQKKPEQGTEVLKFFDWAYKTGAK"
      "QANDLDYASLPDSVVEQVRAAWKTNIKDSSGKPLY")
mtb = "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P9WGT7.fasta", timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
print("E. coli PstS   1-32 :", ec[:32],  "| cleavage 25/26, +1 =", ec[25])
print("M. tb  PstS1   1-30 :", mtb[:30], "| cleavage 22/23, +1 =", mtb[22])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(11, 6.6), gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1.15]})

KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
      'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def hyd(s, w=19):
    v = np.array([KD[a] for a in s]); return np.convolve(v, np.ones(w)/w, mode='same')

ax = axes[0]
h = hyd(ec)
ax.plot(np.arange(1, len(ec)+1), h, lw=1.3, color="#2b6cb0")
ax.axhline(1.6, color="#c53030", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(348, 1.68, "TM helix threshold 1.6", color="#c53030", fontsize=8, ha="right")
ax.axhline(0, color="0.6", lw=0.6)
ax.axvspan(1, 25, color="#f6ad55", alpha=0.5)
ax.annotate("signal peptide 1-25\nmax 1.72", xy=(16, 1.72), xytext=(55, 2.6), fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8, color="0.3"))
ax.annotate("mature 26-346: max 1.51, no residue above threshold", xy=(102, 1.51),
            xytext=(135, 2.6), fontsize=8, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8, color="0.3"))
ax.set_xlim(1, len(ec)); ax.set_ylim(-3.2, 3.2)
ax.set_xlabel("Residue in P0AG82 precursor"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (w=19)")
ax.set_title("A. PstS hydropathy: the single hydrophobic segment is the cleaved signal peptide\n"
             "Phobius run on this sequence: TM = 0, SP = Y, n6-17c25/26o", fontsize=10, loc="left")

ax = axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("B. N-terminal processing: E. coli PstS (SPase I, soluble) vs M. tuberculosis PstS1 (SPase II, lipid-anchored)",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")
def draw(y, label, s, cut, note, col):
    ax.text(0.005, y+0.085, label, fontsize=9, fontweight="bold", transform=ax.transAxes)
    for i, a in enumerate(s[:32]):
        x = 0.30 + i*0.0215
        inside = i < cut
        ax.text(x, y, a, family="monospace", fontsize=9.5, transform=ax.transAxes,
                color="white" if inside else "#1a202c",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.14",
                          fc="#dd6b20" if inside else ("#c53030" if i==cut else "#e2e8f0"),
                          ec="none"))
    ax.plot([0.30+cut*0.0215-0.006]*2, [y-0.03, y+0.12], color="#c53030", lw=1.6, transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.text(0.30+32*0.0215+0.01, y, note, fontsize=8.5, transform=ax.transAxes, color=col, va="center")
draw(0.56, "E. coli PstS\nP0AG82", ec, 25, "+1 = Glu26, no Cys anywhere\nin 346 aa, no lipobox", "#2b6cb0")
draw(0.12, "M. tuberculosis\nPstS1  P9WGT7", mtb, 22, "+1 = Cys23, N-palmitoyl and\nS-diacylglycerol, cell membrane", "#c53030")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
